meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 可以处理时间序列数据，包括分类、预测、异常检测等任务。它会利用 aeon 工具库，对带时间戳的数据进行机器学习分析。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can handle time series data: classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, etc. It uses the aeon toolkit for machine learning on temporal data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide time series data (e.g., stock prices, sensor readings) and request forecasting, classification, clustering, or anomaly detection.

say_en.text: Forecast next week's sales from this week's data.
Find anomalies in this sensor series.
